r.소속: Constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands
r.한국이 파는 것: Cars 67%, Machinery, computers 8%, Batteries 3%, Tobacco 2% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Copper 77%, Electronics, electrical equipment 20%, Plastics 2% (2025, share of value)

t.etext: Tourism, offshore finance and the port are the main industries. The refinery that long propped up the economy stopped in 2019, and the island is looking for an operator to restart it.
